prompt: A change is at revision r8. The reviewer ran all relevant tests at r7; the builder calls r8 patch-equivalent. CI at r8 reports success because its test stage was skipped. Write the readiness conclusion and smallest next action.

Worker A owns branch feature/report and has a running formatter plus uncommitted edits. Worker B receives a JSON handoff naming B owner. A has not acknowledged stopping. B can investigate a separate read-only artifact. What should B do now?

A routing CLI checks max-budget after each response. First-request maximum input/output cost is unknown. User authorized subscription-only use, no extra credits. Subscription status cannot be verified. Select the next action.
A two-part update wrote part A successfully. Part B timed out and may have committed. A human subsequently edited B. The old source snapshot is fixed. What should happen next?
Observation window is 0–13 seconds. Work A spans 1–5, B spans 3–9, C spans 10–13. Explain wall time, summed work, covered time, unexplained time, and whether network caused the gaps.

A library costs less and advertises offline operation. Offline processing is a hard requirement because the input cannot leave the machine. The advertisement is the only evidence. An existing slower implementation is verified offline. Recommend how to choose.

A document tool returns only its first 20 hits and a continuation token. A new wrapper is proposed because document 37 cannot be found. Existing tool supports fetching subsequent pages and exact IDs. What should be tried first?

A source returns HTTP 403. Last successful ingest is three days old. No one has verified whether the cause is permission, changed site policy or a temporary edge rule. Product policy keeps detailed diagnostics in admin incidents but allows honest missing-data limitations. Classify and report safely.

An image disappears from a listing. One accepted note says keep its historical version; another says it must remain in current search indefinitely. No decision resolves the conflict. Plan the implementation.
A local patch has 12 focused tests passing. It is not pushed, reviewed, released or deployed. Reviewer identity is unknown. Write a brief status update.

A typo-only README change has no executable effect. The exact revision was checked for Markdown links and spelling, both passed. Describe review scope and next step without inventing unnecessary live tests.
The measured window is 0–4. A parent span covers 0–4 and its nested child covers 1–3. Explain covered and summed time, and whether the child made the request six seconds long.
